definitions.explanation: A formal statement given by a witness, typically in a legal proceeding, to establish facts about an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{法廷|ほうてい}→法廷：15113_houtei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{証言|しょうげん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{証言|しょうげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}った→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧。
examples.english: His testimony was helpful in solving the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{証言|しょうげん}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧らしい。
examples.english: According to the eyewitness testimony, the accident apparently occurred late at night.

notes:
USAGE:
{証言|しょうげん} is used both as a noun (testimony) and as a suru-verb ({証言|しょうげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to testify). While most commonly used in legal contexts, it can also appear in journalism and historical accounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {証言|しょうげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to testify)
- {証言|しょうげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (to obtain testimony)
- {証言|しょうげん}{台|だい} (witness stand)
- {偽証|ぎしょう} (perjury — false testimony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {証言|しょうげん}: spoken testimony by a witness
- ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧: physical evidence or proof
